claims.gist: PHP vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 affect most of the internet
PHP 5.4 through PHP 8 are affected, forcing migration to PHP 8
PHP runs almost 70% of all websites, largely because of WordPress
Multiple researchers independently find the same bugs, so who-was-first matters less
Credit should go where due; OpenAI, Calif and Wiz were key to disclosure and patching
Embargo breaches are unfortunate, since coordinated disclosure gives defenders time to patch
PHP Foundation criticized Chainguard for publishing a patched image before the embargo lifted
Coordinated disclosure is increasingly hard across decentralized security ecosystems

thesis: Vulnerability credit debates matter less than actionable guidance; coordinated disclosure is harder across decentralized ecosystems.
